text: Good news on your blood work. Now, looking at the dermatoscopic images, do any of the spots show asymmetry, irregular borders, or multiple colors? Also, have you noticed any itching, pain, or rapid growth in these areas?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the detailed history; the combination of a non-healing penile lesion in a smoker with a lesion on the finger is highly concerning for malignancy. Given your history of failed treatment for syphilis and eczema, could you confirm if these lesions were biopsied previously, or have they only received topical creams? REQUEST TEST: HIV_Status, Syphilis_Serology. DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma
